newsitem.title: GERMANY: TENNIS-SWISS TEENAGER HINGIS WINS FILDERSTADT TOURNAMENT.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-SWISS TEENAGER HINGIS WINS FILDERSTADT TOURNAMENT.

text.p: Swiss teenager Martina Hingis overpowered Germany's Anke Huber to win the first WTA tournament of her career on Sunday, taking the Filderstadt final 6-2 3-6 6-3.
The 16-year-old Hingis's win in the $450,000 event is expected to lift her one place to ninth in the world rankings which will be updated on Monday.
Despite losing the final, Huber, 21, should also go up one place, to fourth, after winning in Leipzig last Sunday.
Hingis, seeded eighth, beat Olympic champion Lindsay Davenport of the United States in the Filderstadt semifinals and Spanish top seed Arantxa Sanchez Vicario in the quarter-finals.
